reviews.text:
I recently worked with Graves Pool & Outdoor Living on my backyard project, and the entire experience has been nothing short of exceptional. From start to finish, their professionalism, communication, organization, and commitment to quality were truly second to none.

The level of craftsmanship and attention to detail delivered was outstanding. Each phase and every detail reflects care, expertise, and pride in their work. The crew showed up on time and if they were late it was communicated in advance, The team maintained a clean workspace, and treated my home with respect throughout the build. They were transparent with timelines and expectations, and their communication was consistent and proactive, which is rare in the construction world. They also were proactive and responded quickly with any questions or concerns.

What I appreciated most was their project management and organization. Nothing felt rushed, nothing felt overlooked, and every phase was executed with precision. They turned my vision into a reality that exceeded expectations, and the finished space looks like something straight out of a luxury home magazine.

If you’re looking for a contractor who delivers elite-level work and a professional experience from day one, Graves Pool & Outdoor Living is the right choice. I would absolutely hire them again and recommend them without hesitation.
reviews.author: Mark Mason

reviews.text:
Graves Pools & Outdoor Living did an amazing job on our outdoor living space. The design is beautiful, functional, and perfectly complements our home. Every element — from the stone and woodwork to the layout and lighting — reflects incredible attention to detail and craftsmanship. It has truly added another level of living and entertainment space to our home.

It also means a lot to work with a local company that’s truly invested in the community. You can tell they take pride not just in their work, but in the relationships they build.

The finished product exceeded our expectations, and we couldn’t be happier. Graves Pools & Outdoor Living truly elevates outdoor living spaces and stands behind their work in every way.
reviews.author: Wright Family

reviews.text: We have been wanting to put a decorative Cedar beam and crowfoot truss On our back patio since we built the house two years ago.  The Graves team understood and we drew out a plan and it looks remarkable!  Construction crew was awesome and the painters put two coats of linseed oil on our beam.  Thank you all completed in just 2 1/2 days around a rainy weekend.
reviews.author: BRET ZIEMAN

reviews.text: Graves enhanced our back yard into a heavenly space.  Now the kids and grandkids want to visit often.  The new hot tub integrated seamlessly to our existing pool. 5 ⭐ upgrade.
reviews.author: T Barron

reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience with the team at Graves. We moved into a new home and needed a compete refresh of the landscaping around the house. The team at Graves came up with a beautiful design incorporating low maintenence plants and various types of rock. The Graves team checked in multiple times to see if any punch list items remained and were diligent in making sure we were completely satisfied with the work. We're really pleased with how things turned out and get lots of compliments. We'll definitely use Graves for any landscaping needs in the future!
reviews.author: Andrew Keiser

reviews.text: We worked extensively with the whole Graves team on this project! Was a GREAT experience and would highly recommend! We have really enjoyed it already thus far and look forward to doing so for years to come.
reviews.author: Jordan Ray

reviews.text: The zoysia grass we were told would grow better in shade and stand up to our two dogs better than the type of zoysia grass we wanted isn’t as described to us. Plus, the rocks put on the side of the house where there is a gentle slope do not stay in place. All in all it’s very frustrating.
reviews.author: R.P. Wilson

reviews.text:
We reached out to Wesley Graves for a bid on landscaping our backyard. He was very responsive and made a tremendous presentation that allowed us to visualize what our yard would look like when he was finished.
My wife and I were extremely impressed with his professionalism and attention to detail. Highly recommended.
reviews.author: Lisa Hicks
